messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/chat/stream (hosted-us-west). Auto-pager triggered. span_id=svc-infer-7a3
Amber (oncall): I’m on it, pulling up dashboards. p95 looks okay but p99 is off the charts. Streaming stall rate increased ~6x in last 6m.
Maya (eng-runtime): seeing heavy tail on streaming responses, lots of stalled frames. Live metrics: p50 85ms, p95 310ms, p99 1.8s, error-rate +0.9%.
Kevin (eng-sre): any GPU node alerts in infra?
ops-bot: Node alarm: gpu-node-zh7-12 therm_alert=1, ecc_count increase on GPU0. Recorded ECC events: 12 in last 10m.
Liz (infra): Checking node. gpu-node-zh7-12 reports rising package temp ~93C and ECC correctable errors spike. Could be thermal throttle causing stalls + kernel retries.
Amber (oncall): Possible flaky GPU causing stalls and long tail. If true we should remove node from serving and route traffic away.
Maya (eng-runtime): Agreed. Can we drain that node and kick traffic to fallback replicas? I can temporarily lower max_batch and disable large-sequence batching for affected model.
Kevin (eng-sre): On it. Draining command (k8s):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-zh7-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-zh7-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
Kevin (eng-sre): Also scaling up warm spare pool so capacity remains.
Liz (infra): Creating hardware ticket with colo ops: "ECC spike + thermal at gpu-node-zh7-12, GPU0 high ECC count, request immediate swap/inspection." Ticket ID COLO-4981.
Alex (support): Which customers are impacted? Any enterprise routes hitting that node?
Maya (eng-runtime): Traffic split shows ~8% of requests went through that node in the last 10m (sticky routing). Some streaming sessions for customer org 'AcmePay' experienced stalls.
Customer Success: Notifying AcmePay now. We'll share ETA and mitigation steps.
Amber (oncall): Update: I’m shifting traffic policy to prefer region-replicas and force fallback model variant for 5m to reduce stalls. Command:
```
./rlw route update --service inference --policy region-first --fallback-model rdx-small-v2 --duration 300
```
Maya (eng-runtime): Pushed config, reduced max_batch from 64 -> 16 for chat-model to reduce tail. Logging enabled for KV cache misses.
ops-bot: Drain completed for gpu-node-zh7-12. Pods rescheduled. Eviction count: 18.
Kevin (eng-sre): Observing metrics; p99 starting to drop. Will keep node cordoned until replaced.
Liz (infra): Hardware note: GPU0 ECC correctable errors keep incrementing under load and package thermal events coincide. Likely a flaky memory channel or VRAM thermal edge.
Amber (oncall): Paging escalation: I'm handing incident to Evan (next oncall) for overnight follow-through. Evan — can you take lead on vendor replacement coordination and RCA?
Evan (oncall): Taking over. Thanks Amber — will follow up with colo and vendor and confirm replacement window.
Amber (oncall): Quick status for handoff: node drained + cordoned, traffic rerouted to region replicas, fallback model in place for 10m window, p99 trending down from 1.8s -> 420ms over 12m, AcmePay notified. Remaining tasks: vendor ticket, hardware swap, add ECC threshold eviction, postmortem.
Evan (oncall): Ack. I'll keep a watch for recurrence and schedule node replacement. Also will run targeted replay load to verify no other nodes show similar ECC drift.
Maya (eng-runtime): After changes: p50 80ms, p95 200ms, p99 380ms, streaming-stall-rate down 85%. Logs show repeated lines:
```
[2026-03-14T02:11:22Z] GPU0 ECC correctable error++: 0x1f5 (count=9)
[2026-03-14T02:11:23Z] GPU0 thermal_throttle: package=93C, clock=900MHz
[2026-03-14T02:12:10Z] streaming: stall detected frame_id=4573, backend=gpu-node-zh7-12, stall_reason=kv-cache-stall
```
Kevin (eng-sre): Recommend follow-ups:
- Add a continuous ECC metric alert (lower threshold)
- Implement automatic eviction if ECC_count > 5 within 5m for a node
- Improve per-node thermal telemetry to correlate with load patterns
- Add a playbook entry for streaming stall -> drain -> fallback model
Amber (oncall): Filing immediate follow-up tickets and assigning.
ops-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied, severity reduced from sev2 -> sev3. Auto-notify: statuspage update queued.
Customer Success: AcmePay confirmed they see latency back to acceptable levels, appreciate the quick notice.
Evan (oncall): I'll coordinate swap tomorrow with colo. Leaving cordon in place until HW replacement. If anything spikes back up, wake me.
Amber (oncall): Thanks team. Rest of notes: need a retro focused on workload-induced thermal edges and whether our GPU packing density needs revisiting.
Maya (eng-runtime): Will capture eval traces and a small repro to run on vendor test bench.
Kevin (eng-sre): Postmortem owners: Kevin (infra mitigation writeup), Maya (runtime characterization), Liz (hardware ticket / replacement notes), Evan (follow-up and scheduling).
Amber (oncall): Closing active pager handoff. If p99 stabilizes further in next hour, we can demote incident fully. :thumbsup: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: Incident closed for active paging at 1987657920. Postmortem scheduled and reminders created.
